name: Menorca Preservation grants
summary: Rolling grants for projects on Menorca in four areas of interest: sea, land, energy and plastic, including wildlife recovery and marine monitoring.

status.quote: Menorca Preservation will accept grants all year round and these will be discussed in the MEP's Steering committee meetings, which are held every two months throughout the year.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and send our application form.
